content.text:
The Grey Tooth quest is finished. I gave the Kings' Marker Stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom, and she paid me 100 gold.

The stone shows seven towers standing in water. She says they are the drowned spires off Lilmoth, and the divers of Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth, will know which tower is the marked one.

The wounded Unbound scout, Tah-Leesh, told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it, so I still don't know what it means. I also don't know why the Unbound drain trees or where the Eye of Argonia lies.

I took the Unbound recipe for the seal from the wreck. My notes to the game say I'm carrying about 950 gold, but that figure is an estimate. The next step is either Bell Station for the tower or Fort Chalkmoth first.
